Name: Marine Livestock
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Ever wanna work in an aquarium? Well, this mod doesn't do that. But, it WILL let you take care of a bunch of aquatic animals!

This mod is the result of a collection of various other old aquatic wildlife mods that I've updated. Most notably, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22930]Beachside Livestock[/url] by soysauceicecream, which had open permissions. Other assets included come from very old mods I found on naver and gained permission from authors to share: Shabu did the mini seal, Ichi12 did the crab, flamingo, and brown seal, and PigPenguin did the penguins.

So! To get to the nitty gritty, this mod adds 11 new animals!  Some of them sort of just swim around in the air. Don't question it too deeply, it's just the magic of Stardew Valley. They are as follows:

[u]COOP
[/u]
-[u]Goldfish[/u]: Comes in 5 varieties﻿(orange, white, black, golden, and spotted), and they produce bait and goldfish roe, which can be aged like other roes.

-[u]Crab[/u]: crabs produce clams and rainbow shells.

-[u]Rubber Duck[/u]: These guys produce wild bait. And they squeak!

-[u]Pirate Turtle[/u]: it's a turtle wearing a pirate hat! What more could you want?! They produce bait and bug meat.

-[u]Penguins[/u]: There are 4 varieties of penguin (red, blue, brown, and black) and they'll produce frozen tears and penguin eggs, which can be turned into mayo or hatched for more penguin friends.

-[u]Sea Bunny[/u]: this little guy will produce both green and white algaes.

BARN:

-[u]Manatees[/u]: These large cuties come in grey and blue, and produce green algae and seaweed.

-[u]Dolphins[/u]: They come in pink and blue, and will produce sardines and tuna.

-[u]Seahorse:[/u] Seahorses produce green algae and seaweed.

-[u]Seals[/u]: Seals come in 3 breeds (Brown, Harp, and Mini-Harp) and will produce crabs and squids.

-[u]Flamingos[/u]: Flamingos will produce feathers and flamingo milk (do not eat, toxic)



The mod is also configurable: you can enable or disable each animal as you wish in the config menu.
At some point I want to try to build an aquatic building of some sort for more immersion. Just a place they'd be more comfortable than a barn or coop lol.

Enjoy!
